product.olivetti-lsx-5010.summary: The 25 MHz i486 LSX server offered an optional i860 socket.
product.olivetti-lsx-5010.history: Olivetti offered the LSX 5000 line to medium-sized businesses and departments of large organisations under its OSA architecture. The 5010 brochure presents it as a Unix application server and a server for Open Desktop workstations.
product.olivetti-lsx-5010.architecture: The board allowed extra computing hardware. Olivetti documents optional sockets for Weitek 4167 and Intel i860.
product.olivetti-lsx-5010.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-lsx-5010.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
